About

The New life is an Adventure Sports Documentary Media House. We specialise in capturing and developing meaningful stories amongst the challenges of life around the world.

My Testimony

Ethan Clarke

After losing my dad to pancreatic cancer in 2025, I felt called to pursue a life in search of experience, and joy, without counting down time. So I decided to travel the world, finding new cultures and people and figure out what life meant to me. I challenged myself to take the loss of my Dad as a learning opportunity to move forward from and inspire others also dealing with difficult situations. I called it “The New Life”.

I documented this first trip and made a film out of it on YouTube. It explores ideas of faith through difficult situations, and how bad times can bring out the good in our lives, the importance of art and creativity in our lives. Using "The New Life" as a new way of defining grief, serving as the name given to the life we are forced to live after losing a loved one, and the transformed life we gain from putting our absolute trust in Jesus. It’s the similarity in all of our lives and the life that we go out of our way to live, in search of experiences, after it feels like all hope is lost.

It does, in fact, get better.

This film remains my proudest work, and if I could show you one thing it would be this.

Since releasing it in December 2025 I’ve had incredible reception, with people using it in their own testimonies, comparing it to their own grief.
